technical.summary: Mixed momentum setup with strong long-term trend structure but overbought short-term conditions, weak volume confirmation, and conflicting intermediate-term signals limit swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: PLD shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying spend, and minimal retail interest.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional buying signal from junior members 5+ months old; market fear (38/100) presents contrarian opportunity but lacks confirming conviction or news data.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (432.48), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and imminent CPI event create severely adverse macro conditions for real estate equities.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above 200-EMA with SMA 50/200 bullish cross and supertrend bullish provides long-term structural support, while VIX-driven fear (38/100) creates contrarian opportunity for patient entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme macro headwinds (VIX crisis 432.48, rising DXY, flat yield curve, imminent CPI), overbought short-term conditions (stochRSI, Williams %R), negative volume (CMF, OBV, AO), and price below both 50-SMA and 20-EMA eliminate swing entry conviction despite long-term trend.

decision.entry_rationale: Long-term trend structure (price above 200-EMA, SMA 50/200 bullish) provides theoretical support, but macro crisis conditions and overbought technicals eliminate swing entry conviction.
